description:
You are the Clinical Research Coordinator for the Phase II Diabetes Trial (DM-TRIAL-2024). The study has been set up with event definitions, but data collection forms (CRFs) have not yet been uploaded or assigned. You need to complete the study configuration and begin data entry.

The study protocol requires vital signs to be collected at all scheduled visits. A CRF template file is available on the desktop at /home/ga/vital_signs_crf.xls.

Complete the following in OpenClinica (login: root / Admin123!, active study: Phase II Diabetes Trial):

1. Upload the Vital Signs CRF template from /home/ga/vital_signs_crf.xls to create the CRF in the system.

2. Assign the Vital Signs CRF to the Baseline Assessment event definition as a required CRF.

3. Assign the Vital Signs CRF to the Follow-up Visit event definition as a required CRF.

4. Schedule a Baseline Assessment event for subject DM-102 with a start date of February 5, 2024.

5. Enter the following Vital Signs data for DM-102's Baseline Assessment:
   - Systolic Blood Pressure: 135
   - Diastolic Blood Pressure: 88
   - Heart Rate (Pulse): 78
   Mark the CRF entry as Complete when finished.
